---
# Home page. The title is hidden by styles.css; it is used for the browser tab.
title: "Felipe Almeida"
description: "Felipe Almeida – PhD candidate in Agricultural Economics at the University of Nebraska–Lincoln."
page-layout: full

# Proves to Google Search Console that this site belongs to Felipe.
# Keep it here: removing it can make Search Console lose access.
include-in-header:
  text: |
    <meta name="google-site-verification" content="EvSHiIVDX9F_W8cTaRABuGYjstarUqCEcIdN7q97lo0" />

# The "Projects" section at the bottom is built automatically from projects/*.qmd.
# Each listing below fills one of the ::: {#...} placeholders further down this file.
listing:
  # Large highlighted card: the project whose front matter has `featured: true`
  - id: featured-project
    contents: "projects/*.qmd"
    include:
      featured: true
    template: _templates/featured-project.ejs
    sort-ui: false     # hide Quarto's sort menu
    filter-ui: false   # hide Quarto's search box
  # Smaller cards: every project with `home: true`, ordered by its `order` field
  - id: home-projects
    contents: "projects/*.qmd"
    include:
      home: true
    sort: "order"
    template: _templates/project-cards.ejs
    sort-ui: false
    filter-ui: false
---

    <p class="hero-summary">
I work in agricultural and applied economics, with a focus on agribusiness and the environment. My dissertation estimates the cost of reducing greenhouse gas emissions in Nebraska corn and soybean production and the market and welfare effects of using corn ethanol for sustainable aviation fuel. I have also estimated the carbon intensity of crops and feedstuffs in Nebraska, and at Cepea (University of São Paulo) I measure the GDP and labor market of Brazilian agribusiness.
</p>
